d:
Devbhumi uttarakhand ki pavan dharti, man ganga ki nirmal dhara aur haridvar ki divy mahima ko samarpit sundar bhakti git 'yah devbhumi haridvar hai' prastut hai.
Haridvar, jahan man ganga ke pavan darshan aur ganga aarti ka divy vatavran bhakton ke man men shraddha aur bhakti ka sanchar karta hai. yah git devbhumi haridvar ki aadhyatmik sundarta, kumbh ki mahima aur dharmik mahatta ka gungan karta hai.
Is bhaktimay git ka aanand len aur man ganga ki bhakti men lin ho jaen.
Ganga Bhajan: Ye Devbhumi Haridwar Hai
Singers: Menka Mishra, Prabhakar Joshi
Music Director: Dhanesh Raj
